titles.title: Preeclampsia Prevention for Military Moms Act
Preeclampsia Prevention for Military Moms Act

A bill to require the Secretary of Defense to establish a pilot program on blood pressure monitoring for at-risk pregnant and postpartum beneficiaries under the TRICARE program to increase the rate of early detection of hypertensive disorder related to pregnancy and postpartum, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Armed Services.
